# Preservation sampling outcome
```{r pres}
# read in
grps <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "I", "L", "N", "P", "Q", "Mix") 
dt_list <- lapply(grps, function(i) {
  fread(file.path(output, paste(nameset, i, "preservation_stats", "csv", sep = ".")))
})
dt <- rbindlist(dt_list, idcol = "Sampling")

sum_dt <- dt[term != "", .(
  N = .N,
  moduleSize = unique(moduleSize),
  mean.Zsum = mean(Zsummary.pres),
  is.mod = sum(Preservation == "Moderate"),
  is.str = sum(Preservation == "Strong")
), by = .(term, module)][order(-mean.Zsum)]

fwrite(sum_dt, file = file.path(output, paste0(nameset, ".preservation_summary.csv")))
fwrite(list(sum_dt[mean.Zsum > 2 & (is.mod + is.str >= 7), module]), file = "WSS_names.txt")

```

# Heatmap of WSS/eigengene
```{r}
# K-means Cluster Validation ----------------------------------------------
# load eigengenes
vali_eig <- fread(file.path(input, paste("GNPC", "STRING.INT.WSS.csv", sep = ".")))
vali_eig <- as.matrix(vali_eig[, -2], rownames = "SampleID")
# disc_eig <- fread(file.path(input, paste(ref, "STRING.INT.eigengenes.csv", sep = ".")))

# set up factors for contributor_code
baseline <- baseline[contributor_code %in% grps]
baseline[, contributor_code := factor(
  x = contributor_code, 
  levels = grps
)]

 
# Plotting the clusters -----------------------------
library(ComplexHeatmap)

scor <- sum_dt$term
names(scor) <- sum_dt$module
common_names <- colnames(vali_eig)[colnames(vali_eig) %in% names(scor)]
labs <- scor[common_names] 
set.seed(3)
hm <- Heatmap(
  t(vali_eig),
  name = "Score clustering across GNPC",
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  # column_km = 4,
  column_dend_height = unit(4, "cm"), 
  # cluster_column_slices = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  # column_split = validation_clusters,
  # column_split = data.frame(
  #   baseline[match(rownames(vali_eig), sample_id), .(sample_id, contributor_code)],
  #   row.names = 'sample_id'
  # ),
  row_labels = labs,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = data.frame(
      baseline[match(rownames(vali_eig), sample_id), .(sample_id, contributor_code, age_at_visit, sex, Diagnosis_group)],
      row.names = 'sample_id'
    ),
    col = list(
      Diagnosis_group = setNames(get_palette("BuPu", 4)[-1], c("HC", "MCI", "AD")),
      contributor_code = setNames(palette.colors(n = 12, palette = "Alphabet"), levels(baseline$contributor_code))
    )
  ),
  # Set legend columns parameter
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Eigengene", 
    legend_width = unit(4, "cm"),
    nrow = 2  # Number of rows in the legend (creates columns)
  )
)

pdf(
  file = file.path(output, 
    paste(nameset, "heat_clust.INT.no_cluster.pdf", sep=".")
  ), 
  width = 18, 
  height = 4 + 0.25 * ncol(vali_eig) 
)
set.seed(3)
drawn <- (draw(hm))
dev.off()


```
